referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the basic structure of the kitchen cupboards (particle board with different coatings) and the front cover (particle board with different coatings). Screws and hinges are considered. The countertop is not included. Sink, cooker hood and waste system are included. The kitchen cupboards have an usable volume of 3.36 m3. The area of front cover is 8.9 m2.; Geography: Data valid for Switzerland
